links.comparator_used: P1 full role/safety/structured nine-point prompt with the nine-point schema, compared against P4 with the nine-point schema removed.
links.effect: Removing the schema improved Qwen 3.5 relative to P1 with $p_{\text{Holm}}=0.015; best observed balanced accuracy for Qwen 3.5 397B/P4 was 0.713; the full prompt produced 84 undecidable Gemma 3n outputs.
links.tradeoff: The full prompt sharply degraded Gemma 3n and produced 84 undecidable outputs.
links.quote: Removing the nine-point schema improved Qwen 3.5 relative to P1 ($p_{\text{Holm}}=0.015$), whereas the full prompt sharply degraded Gemma 3n and produced 84 undecidable outputs.
